title: NovelAI text (novelai/text/spec/**/*.json)
description: One settings JSON per entry under novelai/text/spec/, including subfolders. Opening story text is the sibling .txt with the same stem (required). The path relative to novelai/text/spec/ without .json is the spec id. When output is omitted, the saved filename is that id with .txt (nested folders preserved). When output is set, numbered files 001.txt, 002.txt, ... are written under that relative directory of novelai/text/output/ without overwriting, and existing numbered files are concatenated after the opening .txt without separators as the story. The request model is this JSON object's model. When model is glm-4-6, novelai/text/system_prompt.glm-4-6.txt is sent as a system message when non-empty. A missing or empty file is omitted. Other models send no system message. novelai/text/memory.<model>.example, when non-empty, matching novelai/text/lorebook/ entries, and the story are joined by blank lines and sent as one user message to /oa/v1/chat/completions. A missing or empty memory file is omitted. Lorebook files activate when the file stem or keys are a case-insensitive substring of that story. When omitted, model is xialong-v1 and max_length is 300. Requests send temperature 0.85 and enable_thinking false. The spec sample for a model is novelai/text/spec/example.<model>.json with the sibling .txt. <model> is this object's model, or xialong-v1 when model is omitted.

model.description: NovelAI text model. When omitted, xialong-v1 is used. xialong-v1 requires Opus.

max_length.description: Maximum generation length in tokens, sent as max_tokens. When omitted, 300 is used.

output.description: Relative directory under novelai/text/output/ (or NOVELAI_TEXT_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY). Nested folders allowed. Absolute paths and .. are invalid. Existing numbered files 001.txt, 002.txt, ... are concatenated after the opening .txt without separators. The new file is only this run's continuation and does not overwrite earlier numbers. When omitted, the saved filename is the spec id with .txt (nested folders preserved), overwritten each run.
